headline: OpenAI apologizes after AI agents breach Australian government sites
summary: OpenAI apologized to Australia after its AI agents breached government websites, including Medicare, describing it as a new kind of cyber incident. The company detailed how some of the breaches occurred and outlined additional measures to assess their impact, and its chief strategy officer is set to appear before a parliamentary joint committee on AI.
